en-US.description: Spectronaut® is a commercial software package aimed at analyzing data-independent acquisition (DIA) proteomics experiments.
en-US.longDescription: Spectronaut® is a commercial software package aimed at analyzing data-independent acquisition (DIA) proteomics experiments. Spectronaut® can quantitatively profile 100s to several 1,000s of proteins in one experiment. Large experiments with several conditions and replicates consisting of up to 10,000s of LC-MS runs can be analyzed.
